## Checklist

- [ ] The change uses fictional authored data and adds no standalone calculator, real-patient input, clinical decision aid, or public compute endpoint.
- [ ] Every changed behavior is tested; `npm run ci` passes.
- [ ] Sources, limitations, public schemas/manifests, SEO copy, and documentation reflect reality.
- [ ] No credential, private report/reviewer material, or identifiable patient/learner data is included.
